params.negative: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name

card.architecture: Anima 2B anime base (Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE), masked img2img inpaint
card.summary: Regenerate a PAINTED region of an existing image with the Anima model — paint the area (e.g. a face), edit the prompt, and only that region is redrawn while the rest stays untouched. Partial denoise preserves the character's identity/structure, so it's ideal for changing a facial expression on an Anima-generated character without losing coherency.
card.pick_when: You want to redraw ONLY a masked area (face/expression swap, fixing a detail) on an existing image using Anima's anime quality.

prompt.guidance: Type the FULL prompt for the whole image (the painted region is regenerated to match it); the quality prefix is added automatically. Booru tags, lowercase with spaces; artists prefixed with '@'. Lower the change amount (denoise) to keep the original face structure; raise it for a bigger change.
prompt.example: 1girl, solo, brown hair, long hair, open mouth, smile, @artistname

negative.note: Default: 'worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name'.

ui_help.note: Paint over the area you want to regenerate (e.g. the face), tweak the prompt (try a new expression), and send. 'Change amount' controls how far the masked region drifts from the original.
ui_help.good_for: redrawing a masked area (e.g. swapping a face's expression) on an existing image

edit_use_cases: masked inpaint: repaint only a selected region (face/expression change, detail fix) on an existing image, keeping everything outside the mask
